Refitting

Removing

Press the clutch pedal, then refit the clutch pedal switch and turn clockwise/anticlockwise until the retainer tooth can be heard clicking into the seat on the bracket.

Release the cltuch pedal and pull back until it is fully released.

This must be done because if the switch is not fully back, it could hold the clutch pedal forward and prevent the cltuch and flywheel from coupling properly.

Check there is clearance between the end of the switch and the contact plate on the clutch pedal.

Connect the electrical connection to the switch on the clutch pedal.

Connect the negative (-) battery terminal.
